questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

The Chairman of the company ordered all of the employees (1)/ to refrain for making long personal calls during (2)/ working hours in order to boost productivity. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

 [IMAGE: https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/vA4Z-MyppkGwoS0KM3dppwc3Fv6OQHoSAya4uUmQXIiZQS0OmypbFFv4LGfdYMOtmTeICNyWKmf11bF-9IN69xESiQxNlOpil3I32QOJlv6hDcJIU_d2mvhzS-tYfotlFbHxlawE] 

__
 
• In the above sentence use "from" instead of preposition "for"
 
• **NOTE:**__ Verb refrain is always followed by preposition "from"
 
• Below are the list of frequently asked words that are followed by preposition "from'', a student must make notes of them.-

 
• Different from
 
• Abstain from
 
• Borrow from
 
• Derive from
 
• Dissuade from
 
• Prevent from
 
• Prohibit from
 
• Recover from
 
• Refrain from
 
• Debar from
 
• Deter from

 [IMAGE: https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/ndX9JG3xc0xgziugYWSVlt6M0F2xlmciBTc3F2aOXA333mJKs1ybUhz0ooc80p688Tma3W5MIlLWWXRTAFIwzr60Xp4tRQT-vEICmHW9Qptr_-MNbeBZpagdWrAe76H8elpbEPLF] **Correct sentence - **T*he Chairman of the company ordered all of the employees to refrain **from **making long personal calls during working hours in order to boost productivity.*

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

I shall be ______ to go.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

With reference to the given context, the blank is followed after **be **form of the verb. And, **be + past participle **is used to form a passive voice. Hence, word **obliged **that is the past participle of 'oblige' should be used here.

Thus, option 2 i.e. **obliged **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence -* ****I shall be **obliged **to go.*

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

I write ______ my sister every month.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

Here, concept of preposition is brought under consideration.

Let's find out the uses of all the given options :-

In - Used to describe the position of someone or something in an enclosed area or place surrounding it.

Of - Used for belonging to, relating to, or connected with someone or something; to indicate reference.

To - Used when there is a specific destination in mind.

At - Used for precise times.

With reference to the context, letter is written to her sister. Hence, preposition **to **should be used here. Thus, option 3 i.e. **to **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **I write to my sister every month.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which best expresses the meaning of the given word.**

FLOAT
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Firstly, let's find out the meaning of 'float' :- To rest or remain on the surface of a liquid; slide.

Whereas, words 'drown, sink & decline' are opposite in meaning to word 'float'. They mean to fall, drop or go gradually to a lower level.

So, word **slide **best expresses the meaning of given word 'float'. Hence, option 1 i.e. **slide **is the correct answer.

questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

First of all, let's find out the meaning of 'grab' :- To take hold suddenly; to seize suddenly or quickly.

Now, find out the meaning of given options :-

Release - To free from confinement, bondage; to free from anything that restrains, fastens, etc; forgo.

Yield- To give up or surrender.

Hence, word **catch **is the most similar word in meaning to 'grab'. Hence, option 1 i.e. **catch **is the most appropriate answer.

questions.question:
**Improve the bracketed part of the sentence.**

States desperately trying to better their socio-economic report cards don’t need (those) kind of psychological dampener.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Here, concept of demonstrative pronoun is brought under consideration. Pronouns that point to specific things: this, that, these, and those, as in “This is an apple,” “Those are boys,” or “Take these to the clerk.” The same words are used as demonstrative adjectives when they modify noun

questions.question:
**Improve the bracketed part of the sentence.**

The apex court has directed that (their) is a need to bring in mechanism in the Government function to make it transparent.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

The verb used after bracket word is a singular verb. And, we know that **these **and **those **are demonstrative pronouns. And, they are used to denote plural noun. That is, plural verb to be used with them. Hence, options 1 & 2 are eliminated. Also, **their **is used as an object pronoun, at the end of the sentence. Hence, option 4 is eliminated. So, option 3 i.e. **there **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **The apex court has directed that there is a need to bring in mechanism in the Government function to make it transparent.

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

Low education means

P: to the poverty and

Q: gender inequality in the society

R: low employment which leads
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Clearly, the sentence doesn't end with a conjunction. Hence, option 3 is eliminated. Now, Q ends with a noun, and R starts with a noun. Hence, two nouns do not come together. Thus, sequence QR is not correct. Hence, option 2 is the correct answer. Now, R ends with a verb i.e. **leads **that has conjunction before it. Hence, it needs an object. So, the sentence cannot end with a verb. Hence, option 4 is eliminated. Thus, option 1 i.e. **RPQ **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **Low education means low employment which leads to the poverty and gender inequality in the society.

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

We should stop

P: the quality of water

Q: usage properly and maintain

R: misusing water, manage water
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 4**

Here, we can only apply logic to the jumbled sentence. The starter of the sentence describes that we should stop, now a quality of a sentence is not stopped. Also, it is not defined in Q, what should be stopped. Hence, the starter will not be followed by P or Q. Hence, options 2 & 3 are eliminated. Now, sequence RP is grammatically incorrect. Hence, option 1 is also eliminated. So, option 4 i.e. **RQP ** is the correct answer.

**Correct sequence - **We should stop misusing water, manage water usage properly and maintain the quality of water.

questions.question: our country has been ______ in the promotion
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

On looking at the passage, we observe that it is based on that after independence, India has focused on science and development. Science and technology have played a major role in economic growth and social development in the country.

First of all, let's find out the meaning of given options :-

Involved - Committed or engaged; to be a part of.

Revolved - To move in a circular path; to turn or rotate.

Solved - To find a solution.

With reference to the context, after independence, our country has been taking part in the promotion of spreading of science for national development. Hence, option 1 i.e. **involved **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **After the independence, our country has been involved in the promotion of spreading of science for the national development.

**Correct sentence - **After the independence, our country has been involved in the promotion of spreading of science for the national development.

questions.question: ______ of policies made by the government
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

First of all, there is no word like 'abriety'. Hence, option 1 is eliminated. 

Now, find out the meaning of other given options :-

Sovereignty - The state of being supreme and independent power.

Variety - Of different types.

Legibility - Visibility.

With reference to the context, different types of policies are made by the government that has focused on the self-sufficiency and sustainable growth and development all through the country. So, word **variety **best fits the blank. So, option 3 i.e. **variety **is the correct answer.

questions.question: the self-sufficiency and ______ growth
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 4**

Firstly, let's find out the meaning of given options :-

Unattainable - Something which is not achieved or get.

Unreasonable - Illogical; not rational; impractical.

Ending - The situation at the end or cease.

Sustainable - Something that is able to be kept going, as an action or process.

Clearly, every country wants a growth or progress that goes on a constant rate and helps in the future. Hence, word **sustainable **best fits the blank. So, option 4 i.e. **sustainable **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **Variety of policies made by the government has emphasized the self-sufficiency and sustainable growth and development all through the country.

questions.question: technology have ______ the economic growth
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 4**

Here, concept of perfect tense is brought under consideration. Since, the blank has helping verb **have **before it. So, verb's 3rd form should be used here. Hence, option 4 i.e **impacted **is the correct answer. It means to affect or to cause on something; to influence.

**Correct answer - ** Both science and technology have impacted the economic growth and social development in the country in an extraordinary manner.
